summary: First-build validation of TUGMA (B2B RegTech). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass covering auth (login admin+demo, invalid, /me, forgot-password, logout) and all domain endpoints (dashboard KPIs, controls, transactions, exceptions, evidence, reports+stellar, organization). Frontend: full Playwright walk-through of public homepage, all 6 public routes, login (invalid + valid admin), and every authenticated app screen using provided data-testids. All KPIs on the dashboard match the spec exactly (10,000 / 5 / 3 / 2 / 87% / 2). CTRL-005 row exists and control-detail opens. Regulatory intelligence, transactions table (24 rows), exceptions, evidence (pkg-2026-q1), reports, settings (org profile + 7 users + role cards), logout, and protected-route redirect all working.

issues: Console shows repeated 401 from /api/auth/me on every public page load because AuthContext probes /me on mount. Functionally correct (public pages still render) but noisy. Consider suppressing the fetch when no session cookie or catching 401 silently.

action_items: Optional: silence /api/auth/me 401 noise on public routes (catch and treat as unauthenticated without logging error).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py hard-codes secure=True and samesite='none' on cookies — correct for the Emergent HTTPS preview but will break local http testing; acceptable for this environment.
api._find uses limit=1000 fixed; fine for demo but should be paginated for production.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' in backend/.env combined with cookie credentials would normally be rejected by browsers — works here because ingress rewrites; flag for production.

dashboard_summary reads all control_test_runs without organization filter (org isolation relies on control_test_id matching per-org control_code); acceptable in single-org demo but should scope by organization_id for multi-tenant safety.

seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded demo dataset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_tugma_backend.py (pytest, 18 tests) can be re-run for regression. All spec KPIs and data-testids verified. Only cosmetic issue is /api/auth/me 401 console noise on public routes.
